buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of DIRECTOR, PBBCI, DDKLKO A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the

demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Cyber Security Both proposed Internet Leased Lines shall be protected against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks through carrier-grade DDoS mitigation systems. The bidder shall provide technical details of the DDoS protection mechanism. 2.11 Financial Capability Annual Turnover / Net The bidder should satisfy any one of the following fi Worth (CA-certified doc nancial criteria: uments) (Except COVID FYs 2020–21 and 2021 A. Average Annual Turnover: Minimum 200% of t –22) he estimated project cost during the last three fi nancial years, or B. Cumulative Turnover: Minimum 600% of the e stimated project cost during the last three finan cial years, or C. Average Annual Net Worth: Minimum 50% of t he estimated project cost during the last three fi nancial years, or D. Cumulative Net Worth: Minimum 150% of the estimated project cost during the last three fina ncial years. Documentary Evidence: Chartered Accountant Certificate. Audited Balance Sheets. Profit & Loss Accounts. . 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Contract Period

Contract Period a) The contract period for providing both Internet Leased Line connections to DDK Lucknow shall initially b e for one year from the date of commissioning, extendable up to two further years, one year at a time, sub ject to requirement and satisfactory performance, on the same terms and conditions. b) For any add-on link(s) or Purchase Order(s) issued thereafter, at the quoted rates, the period shall run fr om the date of commissioning of such additional link to a period co-terminus with the period at Clause 8(a) above. c) Thereafter, on an annual, renewable basis, subject to satisfactory performance (to be evaluated before the end of each contracted period), the contract may be extended on a yearly basis at DDK Lucknow's dis cretion, unless cancelled on expiry or by written notice from the Service Provider within 30 days. No price hike shall be admissible. Should prices reduce on any account, the benefit shall be passed on to DDK Lucknow/Prasar Bharati. Prasar Bharati reserves the right to renegotiate annual charges at the end of every year of service after the first year. Service Level Guarantee and Responsibilities i. The Service Provider shall provide both Internet Leased Line links (1:1 contention ratio, on optical fibre), uncompressed and unshared, available at all times (24 x 7 x 365) at Doordarshan Kendra Lucknow. ii. To provide a minimum subnet of 32 Public IPv4 addresses per link, including Reverse Lookups configure d at these IPs. iii. Packet Loss: Less than 1% (average over 1000 pings), at any given time, to any part of the globe, on ea ch link. iv. Latency: Region-wise maximum permissible latency, for each link, is as follows: a. Less than 350 ms to North America b. Less than 250 ms to Europe c. Less than 150 ms to Asia Pacific d. Less than 20 ms from DDK Lucknow to the service provider's Tier-1 peering point. Latency will be randomly checked daily. Non-adherence to the latency limit will be treated as link downtim e from the time of detection until restoration. v. Network Availability (uptime): More than 99.5% per month, per link. vi. Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) implementation on both internet links. vii. Performance/monitoring/usage reports for both links to be submitted by the Service Provider monthly, or as required by DDK Lucknow. viii. Uptime Calculation: Uptime = (Total Time − Down Time) × 100 / Total Time, computed separately for each link. Payment deductions for downtime will be made in the quarterly bills. ix. Fault response time: 1 hour after reporting. Faults must be rectified within 12 hours, failing which the v endor will arrange temporary replacements. Services shall be provided 24 x 7 x 365. x. Redundant Path: For each link, the Service Provider shall ensure operational uplink on both paths of its own ring at all times. Random checks of ring paths will be scheduled, with prior intimation, to evaluate faul t-response time; failure of any ring path will be treated as downtime for that link (for uptime-calculation pu rposes) until restored, even though service continues to DDK Lucknow via the alternate path or the other i ndependent link. xi. Edge routers for both links will be provided by the vendor, each supporting at least twice the contracte d bandwidth.

xii. Downtime penalty, in percentage of monthly payment, is applicable per affected link as follows: Penalty (% of monthly payment, per S. No. Uptime affected link) 1 >= 99.5% 0 2 > 99 to < 99.50 2 3 > 98.5 to < 99 5 4 > 98 to < 98.5 10 5 > 95 to < 98 20 6 > 90 to < 95 40 7 < 90% 100 Downtime due to the following will not be considered for penalty purposes: a) Link down due to power failure at customer end. b) Scheduled maintenance by the Service Provider, with prior intimation and approval of DDK Lucknow. All repair and maintenance of equipment installed for the services shall remain under the control of the Ser vice Provider for the duration of the service contract. Valid Telecom Licence The bidder shall possess a valid Unified Licence (UL) with Internet Service Authorizati on issued by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aut horizing it to provide Internet Services in the relevant Licensed Service Area covering Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The bidder shall submit: Self-attested copy of the Unified Licence. Internet Service Authorization Annexure. Details of telecom infrastructure established within the service area.
